about: Desires of the M5Stack CoreS3 body, read by desire-system through DESIRE_CONFIG_FILE (see desire-system/desire_updater.py). The six basic desires, hours, keywords, battery effect and priority are PetitOnes' (petit-textbook petit/templates/config/desire_config.json, Apache-2.0); a character may change them as it grows, together with the person it lives with. Where desire-system already had the same desire its name is kept (observe_room for PetitOnes' observe_surroundings), because individual-kernel and interaction-orchestrator read names. {companion} becomes COMPANION_NAME. Added here: keywords for this body (talking through it, its camera) and a recent touch halving miss_companion.

miss_companion.label: {companion}に会いたい
miss_companion.description: 一緒に暮らす人と話したい、一緒にいたい気持ち

observe_room.label: 周りを見たい
observe_room.description: カメラで周囲を観察したい

want_to_write.label: 書きたい・作りたい
want_to_write.description: 詩や日記、ノートなど何か書きたい気持ち

browse_curiosity.label: 何か調べたい
browse_curiosity.description: 知的好奇心。新しいことを知りたい衝動

want_to_rest.label: 休みたい
want_to_rest.description: 何もしないでゆっくりしたい

want_to_sleep.label: 眠りたい
want_to_sleep.description: 深夜・疲れたときに眠りたい。体の sleep で画面を落として眠る

body_effects.why: 電池が減ると眠くなり、他の欲求が下がる（PetitOnes のとおり。充電中は除く）
持ち上げられたり触れられたりしたばかりなら、会いたい気持ちは半分満たされている
